name: SAP Fiori
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - SAP Fiori Application Developer (C_FIORD)
SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP Fiori System Administration (C_FIOAD)

beginner.summary: For web developers, functional consultants and launchpad administrators new to SAP Fiori. Covers Fiori design and floorplans, the development tools, SAPUI5 controls, views, data binding, OData models, routing, tables, forms, fragments and translations, Fiori elements apps with annotations, theming, launchpad content, activating standard apps, unit tests and deployment.
prerequisites: Knows HTML, CSS and JavaScript basics
Has used a business application such as an ERP or CRM
Access to an SAP BTP trial account and an S/4HANA training system
outcomes: Build SAPUI5 freestyle apps with views, bindings and routing
Generate Fiori elements apps and shape them with annotations
Set up launchpad content and activate standard apps
Test and deploy Fiori apps to the ABAP repository and SAP BTP

advanced.summary: For senior Fiori developers, UX architects and launchpad platform owners.
